resolution: Explained and fixed the 'model named body has no folder named body' report. The model lives at models/props/Model_26/ — a rename-follow bug, not an export quirk: the focus panel's name field renames through the deferred folder-move path (req_3246) but has no end-of-rename event, so the settle that moves the folder never ran; 47 of 230 packages had folder names drifted from their manifest names. Fixed twice over: loadMaterializedPackages now settles any drifted package as it walks the manifests (self-heals ALL existing drift — body, bed_king, vending_machine, etc. — at the next editor boot/reload, loud but non-destructive if a move fails), and renameModel now debounce-settles 1.2s after the last keystroke so panel-field renames move their folder going forward. Library rename bar behavior unchanged (still settles on finish). Editor cart bundles clean; changes are hot-reloadable JS.
